records.text: A news site for 200k daily users. Mostly reads, with a Redis cache and a CDN in front.

design.name: News feed
design.description:
A news site for 200k daily users. Mostly reads, with a Redis cache and a CDN in front.

Scripted mock assumptions:
- Scripted mock: keyword rules only; no AI model was called.
- No region mentioned, so everything runs in US East.
- Started with 2 app servers.
- Added a load balancer because there is more than one app server.
- Assumed the cache answers 80% of reads.
- Turned 200,000 users into 347 rps at the busiest hour (50 requests per user per day, peak hour 3x the average).
- Assumed 90% of requests are reads.
